verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows asynchronous transcription jobs, SDK polling, and an indirect reference to webhooks. Nothing documents attaching custom identifiers or metadata to a job, or having them echoed back in transcript results or webhook payloads. The axis applies to an async transcription API, so absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach my own identifiers or metadata to a job and get them back in results and webhook payloads
